title: PokeClash Cobblemon
description: Welcome to PokeClash! A Cobblemon server just looking to be a fun place to play without everything locked behind a paywall! We have tons of amazing features, and more to come in the future. Come join us and see if we are a fit for you!
body:
Welcome to **PokeClash**! A Cobblemon server just looking to be a fun place to play without everything locked behind a paywall!  Come join us and see if we are a fit for you!

### Server Features
- Non-P2W
- **Every Pokemon is modeled**
- Dex Ranks
- Player Markets
- Player Warps
- Land Claiming
- Research Tasks
- Breeding with Daycare
- Mass Outbreaks 
- Mega Evolutions
- Z-Crystals 
- Terastalization
- Raid Bosses
- Pokehunts 
- PokeBuilder 
- Custom Pokemon Skins
- Custom Regional Forms
- PokeSeller
- WonderTrade
- Cobblemon Leaderboards
- Community PokeTasks 
- GTS 
- Pokemon Trading 
- Player Gym Leaders
- Legendary Spawns
- Keep Inventory 
- Resource World (gets reset regularly)
- Cosmetics
- Custom Terrain Generation
- Server Events
- EV Training NPCs
- Sandwich lures from S/V
- Catch Combos 
- Move Tutors
- TMs/TRs
- Cobblemon Bosses
- Hidden Ability Spawns
- Pokémon Plushies 
- **Ultra Space**
- **ZA Royale**

To join our server you have a couple modpack options:
- [PokeClash Cobblemon Modpack](https://modrinth.com/modpack/pokeclash-cobblemon) (Recommended)
- [PokeClash+ Cobblemon Modpack](https://modrinth.com/modpack/pokeclash-cobblemon+) (Adds extra visual mods)
- [Official Cobblemon Modpack](https://modrinth.com/modpack/cobblemon-fabric) (But you'll miss out on some custom features we have added)
